Seen • 2m
If your tracking never updates, it’s usually because the seller (the creator or business you bought from) hasn’t shipped yet, or the carrier hasn’t scanned the package. Kajabi doesn’t control shipping or tracking, so there isn’t a way to “force” it to update from our side.
What to do next:
Check your purchase confirmation email for the seller’s contact info.
Message the seller and ask if the order has shipped yet and when they expect the first scan.
If it’s been a while, ask them to resend the tracking link or confirm the tracking number.
If you tell me whether this was a physical item or a digital product, I can point you to the right next step.

How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
• 4m
Seen • 4m
There isn’t a standard shipping or tracking timeline inside Kajabi.
Kajabi doesn’t ship products or send tracking numbers. The creator or business you bought from controls that part of the process. They decide when the order ships and when the tracking email goes out. 
So the timing can vary a lot depending on:
whether the item is physical or digital
how quickly the creator processes orders
their shipping method and carrier
If you haven’t received tracking yet, the best move is to check your purchase confirmation email or contact the website or creator you ordered from directly. They manage shipping and tracking for that order.
